summary: OVHcloud AI Endpoints documents an anonymous free access mode limited to 2 requests per minute per IP and per model. API-key access requires a Public Cloud project with a payment method.
claim_steps: Use a supported AI Endpoint in anonymous mode within the 2 requests per minute per IP and model limit.
For API-key access, create an OVHcloud Public Cloud project and define a payment method.
Choose a model from the AI Endpoints catalog and call its OpenAI-compatible API.

social_proof.title: AI Endpoints - Getting started - OVHcloud Documentation
social_proof.text: Anonymous: 2 requests per minute, per IP and per model. If you exceed this limit, a 429 error code will be returned.
